# aec-website

> Website of the Algerian Engineering Competition (AEC). Home page with countdown, about, team and FAQ sections, a registration flow, accepted-teams and winners pages. Live at https://aec.vic-enp.com. Next.js, Supabase.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/puIad/aec-website/blob/main/README.md): what the site is, stack and how to run it

## Source

- [src/app/register](https://github.com/puIad/aec-website/tree/main/src/app/register): registration
- [src/app/accepted](https://github.com/puIad/aec-website/tree/main/src/app/accepted): accepted teams
- [src/app/winners](https://github.com/puIad/aec-website/tree/main/src/app/winners): winners
- [src/app/components](https://github.com/puIad/aec-website/tree/main/src/app/components): page sections
